kind: Lean API refactoring and proof simplification
request: Introduce RootedRamseyGraph carrying the pivot decomposition, improve theorem statements, and assess stronger tactics for counting proofs.

changes.bundle: RootedRamseyGraph s t V extends RamseyGraph s t V with pivot : V. Canonical A and B are reducible definitions, not independently stored data. RamseyGraph.root constructs the rooted bundle.
changes.structure: Membership simplification, pivot exclusions, disjointness, exhaustive membership partition, finite cardinal partition, neighborhood-degree identity, and bundled (4,5) neighborhood and (5,4) antineighborhood for rooted (5,5) graphs.
changes.public_api: Degree-18 budget/connectivity/cross-edge results use R and hv instead of graph/proof/pivot. Local row and column bounds use R and membership in R.A or R.B. All current consumers migrated without compatibility aliases.
changes.generality: Raw-graph counting identities, converse interface criteria and the one-sided TransversalFour API remain unchanged. Raw private cross-row cardinality arguments remain independent of Ramsey hypotheses.
proof_simplifications: card_neighborSet_add_antiNeighborSet: 20 proof lines to 5 using Set.ncard_union_eq, Set.ncard_compl and omega. Removed the now-unnecessary local linter override.
degree_add_compl_degree: 15 proof lines to 4 using SimpleGraph.degree_compl and omega.
RootedRamseyGraph.mem_partition uses grind with the membership lemmas.
changes.documentation: Updated lean/README.md with rooted construction, API example, cardinality normalization guidance and the roles and limits of existing tactics.
